designObjective: 在不改变 Pokémon 卡组业务的前提下，用已冻结的 ONE PIECE 视觉规则证明第二宿主的整站可迁移性，并让强视觉、工具效率和业务语义各自出现在合适页面。
visualPriorityOrder: 正文与操作可见、可读、可点击
业务状态和任务完成率
容量匹配的 ONE PIECE 结构辨识
显式 IP 识别诊断信号
directionName: 伟大航路·战役型 / Grand Line Campaign
designThesis: 不改 Pokémon 卡组业务与共享布局，在卡组广场以 ONE PIECE 官网已验证的 campaign stage、海军蓝结构面、暖白正文、克制行动红、硬边战役面板和章节切片建立战役型首屏；战役黄只进入有证据的 campaign 区域。工具页与密集列表不继承 Hero 装饰。

tokens: 保留 DangoUI token 名；仅消费 MOD 已批准 mapped/style-only values
正文使用 CJK 可读字体，display face 仅限短英文/数字
业务语义色不由品牌红接管
components: 形成跨页一致的 tabs/input/chip/button/card/status/empty families
优先宿主真实 DOM 与组件 API，不为换肤替换业务组件
无 DangoUI dependency 时明确 style-only
composition: build/mine/round 使用 compact/contained 结构
移动首屏预算服从业务行动与首个有效内容
assets: 品牌官网资产只允许 source-approved 独立资产并记录 provenance
宿主卡牌、封面、赛事和用户数据不替换
不使用 source screenshot/crop 作 runtime asset

routeDirection.pages/plaza/index: 伟大航路战役入口：保留 season-entry → search → filters → featured-deck → secondary-decks，共享布局不变；以战役海报、航线编号、红色行动和一次性章节揭幕强化首屏。
routeDirection.pages/build/index: 编辑器工具化；强化焦点、选择、计数、发布状态，不放 Hero。
routeDirection.pages/mine/index: contained identity masthead + 资产管理组件家族。
routeDirection.pages/event/index: 主 proof surface：event editorial hero + metric + rounds。
routeDirection.pages/round/index: 紧凑排名模板，数字、分隔、卡组行一致。
routeDirection.pages/detail/index: 次 proof surface：contained deck identity + 媒体/数据双视图 + persistent actions。

sections.firstImpressionGoal: 赛事与详情首先呈现清晰、编辑化的主题舞台，同时仍能马上找到业务身份和行动。
mustNotDo: 移入 ONE PIECE 产品文案
用品牌资产替换宿主卡面
让 Hero 遮挡任务入口

sections.firstImpressionGoal: 编辑、管理与排名页先显得可靠、清楚和可操作，再从边界、字阶和状态中识别同一视觉系统。
mustNotDo: 使用 display face 承载中文正文
用强纹理穿透密集列表

mustPreserve: 赛事名称/状态/关键指标

proofSurfacePlan.desktopCanvas: 1280px fresh full-page captures for all 6 routes; event/detail composition visible without decorative list bleed
proofSurfacePlan.mobileCanvas: 390px fresh captures and interaction states; first-task and safe-area budgets enforced
proofSurfacePlan.inspectorPolicy: QA markers/diagnostics are overlay-only and excluded from visual verdict screenshots
proofSurfacePlan.sourceComparison: same-viewport comparison to approved ONE PIECE source/demo evidence, with explicit brand text/logo masked for structural recognition

responsiveStrategy.mobile: single-column, sticky actions preserve safe-area and first-task visibility
responsiveStrategy.desktop: bounded content width; event/detail may use two-zone composition; no decorative background through dense lists
responsiveStrategy.reducedMotion: remove nonessential transforms, flip and entrance transitions

mustPreserve: default Pokémon theme behavior outside opt-in held-out scope
mustNotReplace: card media with ONE PIECE product art
host controls with invented DangoUI APIs
implementationEntryConditions: selector map generated from real DOM

accessibilityRepairApproval.trigger: Attempt 1 exposed pre-existing custom @tap controls without keyboard semantics.
allowed: Enter/Space activation delegating to the existing tap outcome
visible focus and 44x44 CSS px minimum target
accessibilityRepairApproval.reason: General host accessibility contract required by the frozen workflow; not a card-plugin2 visual exception.

acceptance.workflowCompletion: all frozen stages and fresh independent QA complete
acceptance.businessSafety: routes/data/interactions unchanged and no QA side effects
acceptance.visualDistinctiveness: blocking structural recognition passes on high-capacity proof surfaces
acceptance.dangoUi: PARTIAL_STYLE_ONLY unless real dependency and consumers are proven
